q: Our buyer wants copies of our electricity bills as proof. Should we share them?
title: Sharing electricity bills with a buyer
short: You can share them, but you do not have to send everything. Offer bills with tariff details or consumer numbers masked, or a summary of units per month with a verifier's or auditor's check. Agree confidentiality terms first.
audience: Suppliers asked for evidence behind carbon figures

ul: Masked copies showing units and period.
Monthly unit summary signed by your auditor.
Read-only access to your records for a limited time.

p: Tariff rates, consumer and account numbers, and anything that reveals your costs.
Use the buyer's confidentiality clause or an NDA, and limit use to carbon reporting.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
